prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 9:16 low-angle circular-fisheye portrait of an original adult woman musician at an unbranded rainy service station at night. She has curly hair, large hoop earrings, a confident friendly smile, a pink long-sleeve crew-neck top, white wide-leg trousers, pink-and-white sneakers, and a lightweight white rain jacket tied at the waist. She stands naturally under a hot-pink neon canopy, holding a plain takeaway cup and making a small peace sign. Include abstract unbranded pumps, an unbranded pink coupe, and wet asphalt reflecting pink and white light, with all signs unreadable. Keep the subject sharp, use a vibrant cinematic rain mood, and exclude celebrity likenesses, brands, and text.
